---

contributor to MP (1869-79)

His contributions are all about the mission work of St. Luke’s, Burdett Road, Stepney; The Times (20 November 1915) records the dedication on 24 November of a chapel 'which has been added to St. Luke's Church, Burdett-road, Stepney as a memorial to the late Rev. Dr. William Wallace, who was vicar there for 44 years.’
